verdict.rationale: Claude Cowork is documented as taking on complex, multi-step tasks and executing them for the user. The user can describe an outcome, step away, and come back to finished work such as documents, organized files and synthesized research. Tasks can also be delegated to run on demand, which is a one-off delegation, separate from recurring scheduling. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that background execution works reliably, documented detail on how results are presented for review or approval before being finalized.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can delegate a multi-step task that the assistant works on autonomously in the background and returns for my review

citations.quote: With Cowork, you can describe an outcome, step away, and come back to finished work—formatted documents, organized files, synthesized research, and more.
Claude can take on complex, multi-step tasks and execute them on your behalf.
Scheduled tasks allow you to delegate work to Claude Cowork by creating tasks that run automatically on a recurring basis, or on demand.
